name: worktree-ready
description: Makes a new git worktree of a Laravel app ready to use with no hands: clones vendor, node_modules and built assets with copy-on-write, links it with Valet or Herd over HTTPS, and cleans it up when you leave.

tool.title: Site tool
tool.description: Which tool links each worktree to a .test site: auto, valet or herd. Auto uses whichever is installed, and does nothing when both are.
